Off Calendar Jul-24-2007 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES:
Appearance:
Edwin Bradley, Esq., appearing for plaintiff & moving party: Ching Fai Ng
Stephen L. Porter, Esq., appearing for Defendant & opposing party: Direct Mail Center

Ruling:
Hearing held and tentative ruling adopted: Plaintiff Ching Ng's Motion To Compel Attendance At Deposition is granted. The discovery cut-off date is based upon the trial date set after objection is made to the initial setting. As Plaintiff argues in the motion, the Notice of Time and Place of Trial is not the trial date until and unless there is no objection to that notice. The Notice of Time and Place of Trial is the same as a tentative ruling that does not become the ruling of the court until the parties have submitted to the ruling or the court has adopted the ruling after hearing. Order signed in open court. COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
